These are intentionally small **mocked** Xcode 16 `xcresulttool get test-results summary` success/failure and legacy `get --legacy --format json` response shapes, plus an Apple two-object `.ips` report shape. Counts and failures are synthetic. They verify field handling rather than claiming to be device test evidence. The real CI retains every raw JSON response beside its bundle so format changes can be diagnosed and captured for future regressions.
